summary: Both editions were independently checked against every clause of the selected Greek. Each preserves the mountain description, proclamation and teaching roles, comprehensive negation with an unspecified object, consistent righteous and truthful conduct, reception of the Holy Spirit, and passage with angels. The simplified edition’s sentence divisions introduce no concrete fidelity defect. The lexical notes disclose their choices without adding a specified fund or an afterlife scenario. The supplied apparatus reports concern adjacent sections and do not require changing this section’s working reading. Acceptance is limited to fidelity to the supplied source and accurate disclosure of the supplied reports; it does not authenticate unseen manuscripts or certify exhaustive collation.
